tools.name: browse_case_studies
tools.description: Browse Impression Digital case studies (our work). Optionally filter by free-text query, service, or industry (id, slug, or name).

query.description: Optional free-text search within case studies.

service.description: Service filter as id, slug, or name (e.g. "seo").

industry.description: Industry filter as id, slug, or name.

navigate.description: If true (default), navigate the browser tab to /our-work/ with matching filters.

tools.name: list_job_openings
tools.description: List current open job vacancies at Impression Digital. Returns title, department, location, and external apply URL. Does not submit applications.

navigate.description: If true (default), navigate the browser tab to /about/vacancies/.

tools.name: search_content
tools.description: Search Impression Digital site content (pages, blog, case studies, resources). Returns titles, URLs, excerpts, and types.

navigate.description: If true (default), navigate the browser tab to /search with the query.
